user_query: I'm a language teacher and I'm looking for new teaching materials for my classes. Can you provide me with a list of all the supported languages for subtitles? Also, suggest some popular language learning apps that I can recommend to my students. Additionally, recommend a website where I can find educational videos with subtitles in multiple languages.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of all supported languages for subtitles from a language data source.
Search for popular language learning apps and compile a list.
Recommend a website that offers educational videos with subtitles in multiple languages.
